additions.sourceIdentityEvidence: ČistéDřevo LA541 explicitly specifies natural beech plywood, 4 mm thick, length 50 cm and width 50 cm. The complete square and natural beech grain match the known ATEHNA beech variant. No supplier brand or unstated glue/core specification is added to the product.

additions.sourceIdentityEvidence: The public listing explicitly offers unbranded galvanized steel sheet at0.5mm thickness with100×100,200×200 and300×300mm square cuts. The complete top square, neutral silver zinc finish and thin cut edge match the unbranded ATEHNA square sheet specification. The same square-family photograph represents those matching square cuts; the300×200 rectangular variant is excluded. Exact selected dimensions remain stated by the variant and retained schematic. No brand/alloy claim, product geometry or supply quantity is changed. Other sheets in the supplier photograph are explicitly excluded in the visible Slovenian caption.
